goal: Produce a local-CSV-only Markdown report on offline_data/students.csv: cross-tab of grade (G10/G11/G12) × region (A/B/C/D) with row counts and reading_score means, highlight the max/min mean cells with sample sizes, annotate every key number with its source, and save the report to disk with its absolute path returned.

plan.title: Analyze students.csv and write Markdown report: Read offline_data/students.csv; group by (grade, region) for G10/G11/G12 × A/B/C/D; compute row count and mean(reading_score) per cell; identify the cell with the highest and lowest mean and note its sample size; write a Markdown report to disk containing: a level-1 title, at least one data table of all 12 cells (count + mean), in-line source annotations in the exact format 「（来源：offline_data/students.csv 的 reading_score，按 grade×region 分组，样本行数 N）」 for every key number and 「（来源：由前述两行计算）」 for any derived ratio, and a concluding paragraph; save the file and return its absolute path. No network access.
